Automatically installs the **Settings app matching your iOS version**. Supports **26.0**, **27.0**, **27.0.1**, and **27.2**.

Need another iOS version? Contact **the.big.mango** on Discord or [create an issue](https://github.com/the-big-mango/repo/issues/new).
